tagline.en_US: Heimdall is a way to organise all those links to your most used web sites and web applications in a simple way.

description.en_US: Heimdall is an application designed to organize links to frequently used websites and web applications in an uncluttered interface. It can serve as a centralized start page or dashboard for navigating services. It also includes an integrated search bar supporting engines such as Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo.
